```
# ============================================================
# n8n + PostgreSQL 18 + External Task Runner
# Kubernetes Production Deployment
#
# Namespace: n8n
# n8n Version: 2.43.5
# PostgreSQL Version: 18
#
# Before deployment:
# 1. Replace all CHANGE_ME values with secure credentials.
# 2. Use different PostgreSQL admin and application usernames.
# 3. Generate a strong N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY (at least 32 bytes).
# 4. Configure your domain and DNS.
# 5. Provision the TLS Secret "n8n-tls" in namespace "n8n".
# 6. Ensure an Ingress controller and default StorageClass exist.
# 7. Configure persistent volume snapshots and off-cluster backups.
# 8. Store production secrets using an external secrets manager.
# 9. Review resource limits and PVC capacities for your workload.
#
# Apply:
# kubectl apply -f n8n-kubernetes.yaml
#
# Check:
# kubectl get pods,svc,pvc,ingress -n n8n
#
# Important:
# - Fresh PostgreSQL 18 installation.
# - Existing PostgreSQL 16/17 data requires a major-version
#   migration before deploying PostgreSQL 18.
# - Database initialization scripts run only on first init.
# - Single n8n main instance; no queue mode or Redis.
# - External runners connect to the n8n task broker.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl

---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL Credentials
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: postgres-secret
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: "postgres_admin"
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "CHANGE_ME_STRONG_POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
  POSTGRES_DB: "n8n"
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER: "n8n_app"
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD: "CHANGE_ME_STRONG_N8N_DATABASE_PASSWORD"

---
# ============================================================
# n8n Secrets
# Keep these values stable across upgrades and restarts.
# Changing N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY can make existing credentials
# stored in n8n unreadable.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: n8n-secret
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: "CHANGE_ME_GENERATE_A_LONG_RANDOM_ENCRYPTION_KEY"
  RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN: "CHANGE_ME_GENERATE_A_LONG_RANDOM_RUNNER_TOKEN"

---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL Initialization Script
#
# Creates a dedicated application user with permissions
# required by n8n.
#
# Executed automatically during initial database creation.
# Existing databases are not reinitialized.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: postgres-init
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
data:
  init-data.sh: |
    #!/bin/bash
    set -Eeuo pipefail

    if [[ -z "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER:-}" ]] ||
       [[ -z "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Missing PostgreSQL application credentials."
      exit 1
    fi

    if [[ "$POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER" == "$POSTGRES_USER" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Application user must differ from admin user."
      exit 1
    fi

    psql \
      -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
      --username "$POSTGRES_USER" \
      --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" \
      -v app_user="$POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER" \
      -v app_password="$POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
      -v db_name="$POSTGRES_DB" <<'EOSQL'

    SELECT format(
      'CREATE ROLE %I LOGIN PASSWORD %L',
      :'app_user',
      :'app_password'
    )
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_roles
      WHERE rolname = :'app_user'
    )
    \gexec

    SELECT format(
      'GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE %I TO %I',
      :'db_name',
      :'app_user'
    )
    \gexec

    SELECT format(
      'GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO %I',
      :'app_user'
    )
    \gexec

    SELECT format(
      'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO %I',
      :'app_user'
    )
    \gexec

    SELECT format(
      'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO %I',
      :'app_user'
    )
    \gexec

    EOSQL

    echo "PostgreSQL application user initialized successfully."

---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL Headless Service
# Provides stable DNS for StatefulSet.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: postgres
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: postgres
      protocol: TCP

---
# ============================================================
# PostgreSQL StatefulSet
#
# PostgreSQL 18 uses version-specific storage paths.
# PGDATA explicitly pins the database directory.
#
# PVC retention policy is Retain.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  serviceName: postgres
  replicas: 1

  persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy:
    whenDeleted: Retain
    whenScaled: Retain

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: postgres
        app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n

    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120

      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault

      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:18
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
              protocol: TCP

          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: postgres-secret

          env:
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker

            - name: POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS
              value: "--auth-host=scram-sha-256"

            - name: POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD
              value: "scram-sha-256"

          volumeMounts:
            - name: postgres-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql

            - name: postgres-init-script
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
              readOnly: true

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "2Gi"

          startupProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -ec
                - |
                  pg_isready \
                    -h 127.0.0.1 \
                    -p 5432 \
                    -U "$POSTGRES_USER" \
                    -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60

          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -ec
                - |
                  pg_isready \
                    -h 127.0.0.1 \
                    -p 5432 \
                    -U "$POSTGRES_USER" \
                    -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -ec
                - |
                  pg_isready \
                    -h 127.0.0.1 \
                    -p 5432 \
                    -U "$POSTGRES_USER" \
                    -d "$POSTGRES_DB"
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6

          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

      volumes:
        - name: postgres-init-script
          configMap:
            name: postgres-init
            defaultMode: 0555

  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: postgres-storage
        labels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        # Uses the cluster's default StorageClass.
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 20Gi

---
# ============================================================
# n8n Application Configuration
#
# Adjust hostname and public URLs to match your environment.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: n8n-config
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
data:
  DB_TYPE: "postgresdb"
  DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST: "postgres"
  DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT: "5432"
  DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE: "n8n"
  DB_POSTGRESDB_SCHEMA: "public"

  N8N_HOST: "n8n.example.com"
  N8N_PORT: "5678"
  N8N_PROTOCOL: "https"
  N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL: "https://n8n.example.com/"
  WEBHOOK_URL: "https://n8n.example.com/"

  N8N_PROXY_HOPS: "1"
  N8N_LISTEN_ADDRESS: "0.0.0.0"

  N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED: "true"
  N8N_RUNNERS_MODE: "external"
  N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS: "0.0.0.0"
  N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT: "5679"

  N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED: "false"
  N8N_PERSONALIZATION_ENABLED: "false"

  GENERIC_TIMEZONE: "UTC"
  TZ: "UTC"

  NODE_ENV: "production"

---
# ============================================================
# n8n Persistent Storage
#
# Stores local n8n application data and configuration.
# Encryption key is also supplied via Kubernetes Secret.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: n8n-storage
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  # Uses the cluster's default StorageClass.
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi

---
# ============================================================
# n8n Application Service
#
# 5678: Web UI, API and webhooks
# 5679: Internal task runner broker
#
# ClusterIP keeps the service private within Kubernetes.
# The ingress exposes only port 5678.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  type: ClusterIP

  selector:
    app: n8n

  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 5678
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP

    - name: task-broker
      port: 5679
      targetPort: task-broker
      protocol: TCP

---
# ============================================================
# n8n Main Deployment
#
# Single replica because the application uses one RWO PVC.
# Recreate strategy prevents overlapping application pods
# during updates.
#
# initContainer waits until PostgreSQL accepts connections.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1

  revisionHistoryLimit: 5

  strategy:
    type: Recreate

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: n8n
        app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n

    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120

      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault

      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:18
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          env:
            - name: PGHOST
              value: postgres

            - name: PGPORT
              value: "5432"

            - name: PGDATABASE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB

            - name: PGUSER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER

            - name: PGPASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD

          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - |
              until psql \
                -X \
                -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
                -Atqc "SELECT 1" | grep -qx 1; do
                echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL and n8n database user..."
                sleep 5
              done
              echo "PostgreSQL is ready."

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "50m"
              memory: "64Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "256Mi"

          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

      containers:
        - name: n8n
          image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:2.43.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 5678
              protocol: TCP

            - name: task-broker
              containerPort: 5679
              protocol: TCP

          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: n8n-config

          env:
            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER

            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD

            - name: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN

          volumeMounts:
            - name: n8n-storage
              mountPath: /home/node/.n8n

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "1Gi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "4Gi"

          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz/readiness
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

      volumes:
        - name: n8n-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: n8n-storage

---
# ============================================================
# External n8n Task Runner
#
# Runs n8n Code node tasks outside the main n8n process.
#
# Uses the exact same version as the n8n application.
# Connects to the n8n task broker over the internal service.
#
# Runners use no persistent storage.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n-runner
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app: n8n-runner
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n-runner
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1

  revisionHistoryLimit: 5

  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n-runner

  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: n8n-runner
        app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n-runner
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n

    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60

      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault

      containers:
        - name: n8n-runner
          image: n8nio/runners:2.43.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          env:
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN

            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
              value: "http://n8n:5679"

            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: "production"

            - name: TZ
              value: "UTC"

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1000m"
              memory: "1Gi"

          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

---
# ============================================================
# Ingress with HTTPS
#
# Requirements:
# - An nginx Ingress controller
# - DNS pointing n8n.example.com to the ingress endpoint
# - A TLS certificate stored in Secret "n8n-tls"
#
# Only the n8n HTTP port is exposed.
# The task broker and PostgreSQL remain internal.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: n8n-ingress
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "50m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "3600"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "3600"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx

  tls:
    - hosts:
        - n8n.example.com
      secretName: n8n-tls

  rules:
    - host: n8n.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: n8n
                port:
                  name: http

---
# ============================================================
# NetworkPolicy: PostgreSQL
#
# Allows PostgreSQL connections only from:
# - n8n application pods
#
# Requires a CNI supporting Kubernetes NetworkPolicies.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: postgres-ingress
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres

  policyTypes:
    - Ingress

  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: n8n
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432

---
# ============================================================
# NetworkPolicy: n8n Task Broker
#
# Only runner pods can reach broker port 5679.
# HTTP traffic is allowed on port 5678 for Ingress and
# webhook traffic routed through the cluster network.
#
# For clusters with strict network controls, restrict HTTP
# ingress further to your ingress controller's namespace.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: n8n-ingress-policy
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n

  policyTypes:
    - Ingress

  ingress:
    - ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5678

    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: n8n-runner
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5679

---
# ============================================================
# PodDisruptionBudget: PostgreSQL
#
# Protects the single database pod from voluntary eviction.
# Note: Cluster node maintenance may require temporarily
# adjusting this budget and accepting database downtime.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: postgres-pdb
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres

---
# ============================================================
# PodDisruptionBudget: n8n Main
#
# Preserves the single n8n replica during voluntary
# disruptions. This is not a high-availability deployment.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: n8n-pdb
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n

---
# ============================================================
# PodDisruptionBudget: n8n Runner
# ============================================================

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: n8n-runner-pdb
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: n8n-runner
```
